summary: Practise project contract records, negotiation preparation and change control. Explore the five-day course and its practical exercises.
lede: Project contract management connects agreement obligations with the approvals, changes and decisions made throughout a project. For project administrators, contract officers and coordinators, it develops practical skills in maintaining traceable records, preparing BATNA-based negotiations, and tracking supplier performance and approved changes from initiation through closeout, using lifecycle maps, obligation matrices and decision logs.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who administer project agreements, coordinate approvals or contribute to commercial decisions without needing specialist contract-law expertise.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with project work or supplier contracts is useful. You do not need specialist contract-law knowledge to complete the course exercises.
